name: d4-legal
description: Legal pages: privacy policy, terms, and an optional cookie notice, written in markdown and edited from the dashboard. Ships clearly-marked starting drafts that must be reviewed before publication, and each page stays unpublished until the owner marks it reviewed, so a placeholder cannot go live by accident.
clientFacingSummary: Your privacy policy and terms, editable by you. Starting drafts are provided to work from, and each one has to be reviewed and approved before it appears on the site.
